_about: Your definition of done: the checks a push needs, each with its why. Yours to change with your Claude: add a check (name, why, run, optionally repos), or take one out. The green merge-check is asked for until this file moves it to a « removed » list with a line saying why, your decision in a sentence of your own (three words or more; this example's text, as it stands, is refused): "removed": [{"name": "merge-check", "why": "your reason, in a sentence of your own"}]. Each push it lets through then shows that why. done-check runs the other checks on the commit to push and records the green ones. A kit update keeps this file as it is; the kit's own default is done.default.json beside it.

checks.name: merge-check
checks.why: The branch merged with its base builds and passes the whole suite, for the exact commit pushed: what CI will build, before anyone else waits on it.
